profile.visual_desc: Tanned elf with long blonde hair and a dark blue headband. Wears olive-drab tactical armor, brown trousers, and a bulky grey backpack with black power cables connected to a large blue shoulder cannon.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Focused expression with sharp dark eyes and straight blonde hair framing the face. Features a prominent dark blue headband and a neutral, determined mouth.
profile.weapon_desc: Massive blue and black energy launcher braced on the right shoulder, held with both hands.
profile.step1_ready: Rear-isometric view facing ↖. The unit stands in a wide, braced stance, steadying the heavy launcher on the right shoulder with cables trailing to the backpack.
profile.step2_windup: The unit tenses and leans into the weapon as a bright yellow energy charge begins to glow at the tip of the muzzle.
profile.step3_impact: A straight, horizontal golden energy beam erupts from the barrel toward the top-left. Frame 4 shows a small yellow projectile spark traveling further along the same trajectory.
profile.step4_finish: The unit maintains a braced posture during the recoil as the beam fades, eventually lowering the weapon slightly to a neutral recovery state.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The golden energy beam and projectile spark align strictly with the horizontal axis of the launcher's barrel, projecting directly toward the top-left target.

evaluation.diagnosis: Consistent mechanics and alignment; F8 VFX deviates from the required fade-out.
